label: campus-reward-vjka.vercel.app
title: CampusPay - Student Verification & Reward Program
reasons: The page collects an identity document (college ID card photo via the `collegeIdFile` upload field) and financial data (`upiId` field) from visitors under the pretext of a ₹600 reward program operated by an anonymous entity with no verifiable company name, registration, or legal identity.

All form data including the uploaded ID card is POSTed to `/api/submit` on a site with no disclosed operator; the fallback host is `campusreward.loca.lt` (a LocalTunnel dev tunnel), and no payment infrastructure or real organization is visible on the page.

The page promises a guaranteed ₹600 UPI transfer within 30 minutes, but the countdown timer unconditionally leads to a 'Verification Unsuccessful' state — the promise that lured the visitor to surrender their identity document is designed to fail.
